name: Karasu Helper
singlePurpose: Help players manage their Karasu website experience: opt-in match acceptance and captain veto priorities, player rank display, server connection copying, and Karasu cosmetic loadouts.

permissionJustifications.storage: Save automation and appearance preferences, favorites, up to 12 named loadouts and a cached public price snapshot locally. Browser-session storage coordinates duplicate prevention, action history and temporary tab-discard preferences. No browser sync or developer server is used.
permissionJustifications.offscreen: Create the bundled clipboard.html helper only when the user-enabled Auto-copy connect feature needs to write a validated ready-match server command. It is closed after the operation; no visible page is opened.
permissionJustifications.clipboardWrite: Write connect IP:port for the user's participating Karasu match after they enable Auto-copy connect. The extension never reads the previous clipboard contents and does not launch or control the game.
permissionJustifications.https://karasu.live/*: Run the bundled page adapters on Karasu pages to detect match-ready and captain-turn state, call the site's existing actions only when enabled, display rank fields beside the correct player and relay user-selected catalog/cosmetic operations. This content-script scope does not grant access to other websites.
permissionJustifications.https://api.skinport.com/*: Optional access requested only when Update prices is clicked. Read public CS2 item prices in USD without cookies, API keys or Karasu/player identifiers. Bundled prices remain usable when access is refused. No automatic provider polling.
